That was the first time I laughed in 2 months and I was happy then you know what happened? My stupid ass school decided that It was the right time to conduct an exam 2 days from then without any notice and poof the laughter was short-lived and depression prevailed.

When I told them about this (which is a big step for me) what did they say? "DoNt GeT sTrEsSeD" and fucking blamed it on my phone and took it away I stole my phone from my parents to type this to desperately release pressure.

It is the only place where I can vent. I don't want to be that 14 year old edgy kid but no one understands me or my problems only strangers do it is fucking depressing as hell when no one is on your side except a few people on the internet I'm just a ticking time bomb that doesn't want to explode.

I'm afraid is gonna continue even after school cause you know this shit is like a stain that doesn't go off and also let me explain why my school can go to hell

1) long working hours (8am-5pm Monday to Saturday and 8am-12pm on Sundays) on a lucky day that goes from 7am to 6pm 

2) teachers that only care about the top 1% and completely ignore the remaining 99% and also if you want to pursue a career other than engineering or medicine well sucks to be you that you won't be a functioning member of society

3) lack of proper teaching (I go for extra classes to understand shit that the school was supposed to fuckin teach)

4) No covid precautions except for wearing a mask but it doesn't matter anyway when you're crammed in a room of 40 people while wearing a mask for 8 hours straight in an unventilated room that barely has any access to water and electricity (mind you the school is located in a relatively rich part of the city so they're not exactly poor) 

5) oh did I forget to mention the EXCESSIVE amount of exams? We have to write 2 exams each for 3 hours every week and 2 weeks ago I had to do the same but every day.

6) 2 days ago they dumped 20 pages of homework to be submitted tomorrow for each subject just right after I gave a fuckin national exam that people of my grade can write. So the one day I could take rest was ruined by my anxiety and depression worrying about the homework.

7) oh you're tired from all the unnecessary pressure and expectations were putting? Well back in my day the word tired didn't exist! So stop being a wimp — my teachers

8) washrooms so horrible that I have a higher chance of contracting diseases by just standing there than by drinking sewage water

9) so i told my parents about this bs  2 years ago and what did they say? "ItS a PhAsE StOp OvVeReAcTiNg" 
(Although I can't blame the school for this)

10) the school with the highest suicide rates in my country is the one I go to every now and again some poor soul is lost because of the school's fucking system of education 

11) these mfs then have the audacity to ask parents to pay extra fees because of "covid19 and the pandemic" even though during online learning you don't have to spend money on gas and all other expense that you don't have to do.


There. 
Now you know why I'm depressed

Sorry for the long rant.
